sloka: प्रवाति पवनः श्रीमान् किम् नु नाद्य यथापुरम् ।भेरीमृदङ्गवीणानाम् कोणसम्घट्टितः पुनः ॥२-७१-२९॥
transliteration: pravāti pavanaḥ śrīmān kim nu nādya yathāpuram ।bherīmṛdaṅgavīṇānām koṇasamghaṭṭitaḥ punaḥ ॥2-71-29॥

translations.english: ﻿﻿ Why is it that the sounds of musical instruments like mrudangas and veenas are not heard now? Why is the city filled with melancholy?
